name: Window Resizer
summary: Resizes the browser window or viewport to saved presets or custom dimensions, with shortcuts and import/export, for testing layouts at different resolutions.
browsersNote: AMO and the Edge store have same-name listings by other publishers; neither was confirmed as this project on the check date.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the Chrome store page.
goodFor: Testing layouts at saved viewport presets or custom sizes.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: window resize viewport resolution presets shortcuts responsive
